title: Crucible — arcane/cosmic creatures, bosses
authority: Design text only. Does not rewrite native-bible catalogs, volume density weights, the Un-Ender clock, the Compound Mark clock, Canon lore, countries.json, or prior slices S01–S16.

canon_pins.refusal_worlddef: A system that refuses to close can never rest.
canon_pins.the_no: A thing that refuses completion cannot be written down.
canon_pins.law_text: If it would end, un-end it.
canon_pins.fight_style_for_people: Sword, as stamped on npc_role_crucible_mystic. People are CX. The focus is wpn_focus_crucible_unend.
canon_pins.humanoid_body: CX only for people. The lattice walker is CX. mon_boss_unender is amorphous. mon_crucible_drift is amorphous. hyb_latticebasilisk is serpentine. faun_lattice_moth is a winged critter. None of those four is a CX body. mon_grid_construct is topology humanoid and stays at Crucible cap 0.
canon_pins.flower_law: Hub only. Canon.HubLawRadius is 42 m and does not govern the Crucible. A thrown shard dragged inside that disk and outside the Arena dies as flowers.
canon_pins.sere_is_not_a_ring_neighbor: Sere is a waystone. The only megaworld route into Sere in WorldGeography.BuildBordersAndRoutes is Crime–Sere. The Compound Mark adjacency is a law and a foundry evening, not a shared disc.

pinewood_crossing.rule: The post stays Hub. No moth, drift mass, basilisk, walker, or Un-Ender stands on that verge.

a fourth shard counted as anatomy
basilisk as echo_serpent or as crucible_warden

canon_pins.drift_rule: WorldDef lists drift. mon_crucible_drift carries canon_kind_alias drift. This facet fields it at cap 2 on gap_eng_procgen.
canon_pins.wraith_rule: WorldDef lists wraith. mon_ruins_wraith is a Ruins id. hyb_mercywraith is Superhero and Ruins and S07 set both caps to 0. Neither id is a Crucible row. The alias resolves to nothing here.
canon_pins.construct_rule: WorldDef lists construct. mon_grid_construct carries canon_kind_alias construct and lists Crucible in world_ids. S11 set the Crucible cap to 0 and the Cyber cap to 1. This slice does not reopen either number. hyb_censusconstruct stays at cap 0.

faction_id_note: Volume quests delta a faction_id open_lattice. The walker role stamps open_lattice. factions.json has neither string. It has crucible_witnesses, crucible_drift_cultists, crucible_lattice_engineers, crucible_drift_refugees, crucible_procgen_collective, and crucible_meta_witnesses. Lore also names calvex_forge, lattice_cohort, kell_circle, and verge_scouts on NPC rows. This slice's deltas use the six country ids only. The volume file and the role file were not corrected. Generated faction ids in factions-extra.json are not given standing.

geography.method: Floors are a gap derived from CountryCenter circles, or an unplaced kit piece. A faction capital is a rim, not a paddock. District anchors in countries.json are the capital plus (8, -6), which is 10 m, and they sit inside the parent radius. They are not wilds and they are not hash places. Where both radii are equal, the capital midpoint is the center of the open. Where they differ, the floor is the point on the segment at radius_a + open/2 from capital A.
geography.sliver_note: Engineer capital (48.72, -36.71) radius 25.5 has outer rim 86.50 m. The wilds ring starts at 90 m. The 3.50 m sliver cannot hold a 4 m module. Cap 0.
geography.foundry_fit: arch_ix_crucible_foundry module_m is 4. The snap line is a foundry bay 2x2, which is 8 m on that grid. One 4 m module fits the 7.66 m throat. The 8 m bay does not. This slice recommends the throat for one module and does not move the seat onto a wider field to force the 2x2. The kit still has no Canon transform.

opens.bay_note: 3.72 m is narrower than the foundry module of 4 m. Moths at 0.08x player height fit. A 4 m module does not. An 8 m 2x2 bay does not.

One 4 m foundry module centered here has 1.83 m of open on each side. This is the narrowest country gap that clears 4 m, and the recommended seat for one module. Six wider gaps also clear 4 m and stay cap 0. An 8 m 2x2 bay does not fit this throat. The kit still has no Canon transform. The recommendation is not a placement.

opens.floor_method: On the segment, 25.5 + 12.75 m from the engineer capital. The capital midpoint sits 1.25 m off that point because the radii differ. This 25.50 m open can hold a 4 m module and an 8 m bay. It is the drift floor, not the foundry seat.

wider_opens_cap_0.note: Narrowest open that clears an 8 m 2x2 bay. Cap 0. Not a foundry seat and not a beast floor.
Field. Cap 0. Witnesses list engineers as a disputed border. The circles do not overlap.

fauna_caps.despawn_rule: If the wing pattern completes, the moth is already dead. Remove the four. Do not aggro them on the way out.
fauna_caps.clear: The teal vein stops before the wing edge. The four stay.

fauna_caps.body_rule: Three orbiting shards maximum. A further flare is VFX and is not a hitbox, a plate, or a loot shard.
fauna_caps.clear: The flare is refused as anatomy. Both masses remain. Killing either fails the window and drops no unclosed_shard.

fauna_caps.density_note: Absent from the Crucible fauna list. This slice does not add a weight.

fauna_caps.hook: verb_hyb_rewind_dodge rewinds a connected dodge once per cast. The rewind is the tell. It is not a license to finish the cage.

fauna_caps.shares_floor_with: enc_rib_notch at different hours. Morning basilisk is absent during 20–23.

role_budget.window_loan: During enc_vein_short, one of the four stands on gap_wit_procgen. The other three stay on spans and cart. When the window is suppressed by enc_unender, all four stay on spans and cart. Budget does not become 5.

mini_bosses.name: Rib notch
mini_bosses.telegraph: The cage of quartz leans toward a close. The notch is the read at the silhouette.
mini_bosses.audio_tell: Music-box click on the rewind only.
mini_bosses.player_response: Take the rewind once. Leave the ribs short. skill_craft_unend on the notch keeps the cage open. A killing blow fails the window.

mini_bosses.name: Two masses
mini_bosses.telegraph: Each mass shows three shards. A fourth light appears between them and must stay light.
mini_bosses.audio_tell: A tone that almost resolves and drops.
mini_bosses.player_response: Hit the open seam on a mass if you must move it. Do not strike the flare. Do not log the flare as a plate. Killing a mass fails the window.

mini_bosses.name: Vein short of the edge
mini_bosses.suppressed_when: enc_unender schedule is open the same night. Moths stay ambient. The loaned walker returns to the cart.
mini_bosses.telegraph: One teal vein on each moth lengthens toward the wing edge and toward the 3.72 m open, as if the two country rims were a pattern to finish.
mini_bosses.player_response: Un-end the vein with skill_craft_unend or by breaking the walker's stitch without striking the walker. A completed pattern despawns the four as already dead and fails the window.
mini_bosses.charter_note: The Witness Charter says observe and do not intervene. Stopping the vein is an intervention. The clear still follows the world law, un-end. The log will be argued between Sael and Orla. This slice does not split crucible_witnesses into two faction ids.

compound_mark_adjacency.name: Missing numeral

crucible_face.reason: Hour 20 belongs to enc_unender on the nights that cron also opens the gap. The Mark's own window runs through 20 on Sere. The Crucible face ends at 19 so the two Crucible clocks do not share an hour.

floor.recommendation_is_one_module: A single 4 m module. The kit snap is a 2x2 bay of 8 m, which this throat cannot hold. gap_proc_meta at 14.74 m is the narrowest open that clears 8 m. It stays cap 0 and is not the seat.

compound_mark_adjacency.law: The clock face is missing its last numeral. That missing numeral is the Crucible reading of a bill the Compound Mark would compound. Leaving it missing is the clear. Stamping a digit, bolting a brand tile, or carrying item_rem_furnace_eye into the bay fails the window and does not spawn the kiln.

boss.name: The Un-Ender
boss.player_response: Do not fill the gap with a body. skill_craft_unend or skill_steel_shard on the seam forces a completion the ring cannot refuse. Stop before the offer becomes a ninth law. Walking out of the open stamps refused completion and is a legal win.
boss.skill_id_mismatch: The monster row names skill_craft_lattice_unend. The skills catalog and the volume phase name skill_craft_unend. This slice follows the volume id and does not mint the other string.
boss.drop_rule: The seam drops only if completion was forced and the gap is still the face. Walk-away drops nothing. A ninth-close drops nothing. closed_ring_fragment in the monster loot list is not a second item id in this slice.
boss.boss_rule_cited: Walking out of the arena stamps WorldEventLog 'refused completion' and counts as a win. It does not drop the fragment.

token.notes_cited: Seam token. Completing it fails the drop.

side_quests.title: Foundry gap — Leave the rib open

objectives.text: Stand in the 7.66 m open while the basilisk window can exist.
See the quartz ribs fail to meet. The notch is the third alloy staying untaught.
Leave the cage short. Do not write the recipe the master withheld.

side_quests.hidden_withheld: The third alloy's recipe is not in this quest. Rina rediscovered two. The master's refusal stands.

side_quests.title: Engineer gap — Three plates, and light

objectives.text: Reach the 25.50 m open between the engineers and the collective.
Count three shards on a mass. The flare between the pair is not a fourth.
Report the count as three. A closed tally is a failed watch.

side_quests.hidden_withheld: Orla's player-conditional drift class is not the flare, and it is not explained here.

side_quests.title: Witness gap — The vein stops

objectives.text: Night, in the 3.72 m open, on a night the Un-Ender is not up.
Stop the teal vein before the wing edge. The moths stay in the air.
Log a stop. Do not log a corrected bowtie, and do not strike the walker who was stitching.

side_quests.difference: q_crucible_moth rejects a symmetric lie. This quest enforces the despawn rule on a measured open: a finished pattern is a dead moth.

side_quests.title: Clock gantry — No digit for the bill
side_quests.if_unplaced: The reach objective cannot complete. The board says the bay has no transform. Do not satisfy it at a capital.

objectives.text: Stand at the unclosed clock during enc_numeral_open.
The last numeral is absent while the Compound Mark walks on Sere. It does not walk here.
Leave the face short. Do not bring the cooled furnace eye into the bay.
